[Intro]
[Bb]

[Verse 1]
[Bb]When the rain is blowing
[F]in your face,
[Ab]And the whole world is on
[Eb]your case,
[Ebm]I could offer you a
[Bb]warm embrace
[C7]To make you [Eb/F]feel my love.
[Bb]

[Verse 2]
[Bb]When the evening shadows and the
[F]stars appear,
[Ab]And there is no one there to dry
[Eb]your tears,
[Ebm]I could hold you for a
[Bb]million years
[C7]To make you [Eb/F]feel my love.
[Bb]

[Chorus]
[Eb]I know you haven't made your
[Bb]mind up yet,
[F#aug]But I will [Eb]never do you wrong.
[Bb]
[Eb]I've known it from the moment
[Bb]that we met,
[C7]No doubt in my mind where you belong.
[F]

[Verse 3]
[Bb]I'd go hungry; I'd go
[F]black and blue,
[Ab]I'd go crawling down the a-
[Eb]venue.
[Ebm]Know, there's nothing that I
[Bb]wouldn't do
[C7]To make you [Eb/F]feel my love.
[Bb]
[Bb]
[F]
[Ab]
[Eb]
[Ebm]
[Bb]
[C7]  [Eb/F]
[Bb]

[Chorus]
[Eb]The storms are raging on the
[Bb]rolling seas
[F#aug]And on the [Eb]highway of regret.
[Bb]
[Eb]The winds of change are blowing
[Bb]wild and free,
[C7]You ain't seen nothing like me yet.
[F]

[Verse 4]
[Bb]I could make you happy, make your
[F]dreams come true.
[Ab]Nothing that I would-
[Eb]n't do.
[Ebm]Go to the ends of the
[Bb]Earth for you,
[C7]To make you [Eb/F]feel my love
[Bb]
[C7]To make you [Eb/F]feel my love
[Bb]
title: Make You Feel My Love
tuning: E A D G B E
